text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT P0] 3923456789 - Multiple ELB target groups showing unhealthy hosts and spike in 5xxs in us-west-2. Pager duty escalation to #incidents.

ben-sre: taking this. I'm on-call. seeing alerts: ELB unhealthy_count > 18%, backend 502/504 surge.

alex-eng: confirmed in logs — connection resets + target deregistrations around 10:02 UTC. looks like ENI detach flapping in azb.

sarah-ops: dashboard: 15% error rate bump across generation endpoints for us-west-2 prod. latency up ~300ms. customers complaining via support.

mohit: throwing the CloudWatch query here: `filter @message like /5../ | stats count(*) by status` — lots of 502s. stack traces show `accept()` failing with ECONNRESET.

ben-sre: quick impact call: scope = prod in us-west-2, affects hosted API endpoints and some Dedicated pools pinned to azb. Not global.

jess-product: status—support notified: Affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants on dedicated capacity in us-west-2, and self-serve traffic ~12% failure rate. Notifying SLAs.

alex-eng: pulling instance events: `aws ec2 describe-instance-status --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-2b` — several EC2s show network-interface detach events and EBS io-throttle logs.

ben-sre: hypothesis: underlying host networking degrading -> instances losing ENI attachments intermittently -> ELB marking targets unhealthy -> route oscillation.

sarah-ops: can we push traffic away from us-west-2 while we stabilize?

ben-sre: plan: 1) shift Route53 weighted routing to move 60% of prod traffic to us-east-1, 2) drain unhealthy ELB target groups in azb, 3) spawn replacement ASG in us-west-2a/c and re-register healthy targets.

alex-eng: creating Route53 change now. snippet:```json
{"Comment":"emergency shift","Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood-inference.internal.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-east-1-weight","Weight":60}}]}
```

mohit: good. also enable ELB cross-zone load balancing? currently enabled, but need to re-check connection tracking on NAT gateways.

ben-sre: executed change at 10:07 UTC — AWS change-id: ZR3ABCDEF. Route53 console shows propagation starting.

incident-bot: Route53 change ZR3ABCDEF queued, expected TTL propagation ~60s.

alex-eng: while traffic shifts, I'm increasing ASG desired count for worker pools in us-west-2c by +30% to replace failing instances. running: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name prod-workers-usw2c --desired-capacity 26`

ben-sre: draining targets from tg-0a1b2c3d in azb to stop error tail and let healthy nodes handle in-flight. `aws elbv2 deregister-targets ...`

sarah-ops: monitoring: error rate already dropping to ~7% within weight shift window. sessions are rebounding for most customers.

jess-product: support note: telling impacted customers we are routing traffic to healthy region and working on stability in us-west-2. ETA for stabilization: 30-45m contingent on instance replacements.

mohit: found controlplane logs indicating NAT gateway SNAT exhaustion in azb causing connection resets under bursts. opened AWS ticket with support — SR-987654321.

ben-sre: good find. mitigation: increase NAT GW throughput by adding ephemeral NATs in us-west-2c and rotate route table association for private subnets.

alex-eng: NAT GW add request done. spinning up 2 additional NATs now, will re-associate route tables to balance.

ben-sre: handoff — I need to step into exec bridge. @mohit you're taking incident lead for mitigation and stabilization for next 45m. @alex-eng you own infra changes (ASG/NAT). @sarah-ops own customer comms and severity page.

mohit: on it. taking lead. updating incident channel with playbook steps & checklist.

incident-bot: Incident ownership changed: ben-sre -> mohit at 10:12 UTC. Pager duty notification sent.

alex-eng: ASG replacements healthy, ELB target healthy_count back to baseline in us-west-2a/c but azb still shows intermittent detach.

sarah-ops: customer-impact update: error rate stabilized ~3% overall; enterprise tenants report intermittent 5xxs but mostly serviceable. marking as partial degradation.

jess-product: start drafting post-incident summary and incident severity board entry. Owner: mohit. ETA draft 4h.

mohit: next steps: keep Route53 weight at 60/40 until azb ENI detach flapping fully resolved and NAT GW scale verified. once stable, slowly shift traffic back in 10% increments with monitoring.

ben-sre: adding follow-up tasks: create runbook item for NAT SNAT exhaustion detection (INC-2026), update capacity docs for ASG buffer in west, and escalate to AWS for root cause on ENI detach.

alex-eng: logs + snapshots saved to s3://redwood-incident-archive/3923456789/ for postmortem.

incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai at 10:18 UTC: partial degradation in us-west-2, mitigation in progress.

sarah-ops: handing off final channel updates to on-call followup. I'm staying on customer comms.

mohit: will run 30m stabilization window then reassess for rollback. tagging @jess-product for postmortem comms.

pagerduty: Reminder: please acknowledge all follow-up alerts and close when resolved.

ben-sre: stepping out of active mitigation. if anything spikes, @mohit please page me.

mohit: acknowledged. closing live bridge in 20m unless new alerts. postmortem owner: mohit.
